referencePixelCoverage: All 107 listed 250 m squares; five independently retrieved official supplemental exports cover the three southern boundary and two southern distant-context squares outside the measured mosaic.
reviewStatus: Corrected source capture fully inspected with explicit architectural and source-data gaps; no exact visual-parity acceptance.
limitations: North-up square perspective game cameras and off-nadir reference imagery displace elevated roofs differently. Reference acquisition dates remain unknown; this is not a pixel registration score.

Literal OSM heights, minima, footprints, courtyards, source road geometry and access stay authoritative over apparent imagery conflicts. Untagged heights, roof rises, facade materials and architectural details remain measured estimates or native approximations.

Airport runway/taxiway and apron surface widths, yellow guidance, stand markings, pavement joints, ground-service equipment and aircraft occupancy remain simplified or absent. The four visible contextual aircraft and terminal/jetbridge detail do not establish an accurate airport operations scene.

Mapped parking geometry is retained, but bay coverage and generated parking occupancy differ visibly from the reference. Sparse cars in some lots and the reference construction state are explicit visual gaps.

Tree crowns remain stylized and their texture, overlap and canopy density differ from the aerial imagery. The 700 individually reviewed raw Otopeni non-crowns were removed without blanket thinning; ambiguous vegetation and 13 mapped OSM trees remain preserved. This is not an individual census of every automatic candidate.

The dataset retains 14686 mapped/measured source tree entries; this capture places 14664. The 22 native geometric exclusions remain: 14 road-ribbon checks, six landmark-ground checks and two below an elevated road surface. No performance tree cap is reached. The total scene also includes 634 procedural trees outside surveyed coverage.

All 1208 supplied literal roof profiles compile, but 37 prepared roof-surface caches fall back to native source geometry in this capture. Roof plant, skylights, multi-part roof detail, facade ornament and unmeasured materials remain visibly simplified.
Field cultivation, dry/brown grass, scrub, garden boundaries and the water park slides are not represented with full reference detail. The reference date/season and construction state may differ.

Partial boundary squares include land beyond the exact 600 m ring; the private review dims that exterior. Four optional distant squares are separately labelled outside-ring and retain coarse contextual treatment.

These world-only top-down captures disable moving traffic and mirrors. Full public-road Street View, native walking/driving, grade and bridge clearance, drone-controller coverage, street/night/winter context and evolving traffic/mirror budgets remain separate acceptance gates.

reviewedSheetGroups.finding: Northern boundary, open fields, logistics roofs, roundabout and parking compared. Detailed agricultural texture, parking occupancy, roof plant and canopy form remain visibly simplified; exterior portions are dimmed.

Terminal, four contextual airliners, apron, terminal approach and railway/road crossings compared. Yellow taxiway/stand markings, ground service detail, detailed terminal roofs and real parking occupancy remain missing or simplified.

Airport open ground, runway/taxiway squares and western highway edge compared. Source extents retained; pavement widths/detail, guidance markings, dry-field texture and parked-car density remain unresolved visual gaps.
Water park, commercial roofs, woodland and central/southern source blocks compared. Slides, roof equipment, detailed garden edges and crown texture/overlap remain simplified.

Southern housing, source courtyards, field boundary and all four optional distant squares compared. Broad source roof/block coverage is present; detailed roofs, gardens, canopy shape and sparse coarse outside-ring scenery remain explicit gaps.
